		has_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_1
		has_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_2
		has_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_3
	}

# the Slips modifiers are the ones of the tier the arsenal stands at
DA_OT_slips_in_step = {
	OR = {
		AND = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes has_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_3 }
		AND = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_2 = yes NOT = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes } has_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_2 }
		AND = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_1 = yes NOT = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_2 = yes } has_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_1 }
		AND = { NOT = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_1 = yes } NOT = { DA_OT_any_slips = yes } }
	}
}
